dialogues.speaker: Choiseul
dialogues.text: Awesome! Everything in the Fontaine Research Institute is so well organized!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's the state of the Fontaine Research Institute?

dialogues.speaker: Choiseul
dialogues.text: The Fontaine Research Institute? If you ask me, it's heading in the right direction.

dialogues.speaker: Choiseul
dialogues.text: Without that arrogant fool Edwin, everything is in much better order!

dialogues.speaker: Choiseul
dialogues.text: It's no exaggeration to say that the Fontaine Research Institute seized the chance to be reborn. We are free of all burdens and attachments and able to fully dedicate ourselves to...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This is where I'll take my leave.

dialogues.speaker: Choiseul
dialogues.text: Goodbye. The Fontaine Research Institute welcomes you at any time.

dialogues.speaker: Choiseul
dialogues.text: Oh, sorry about that. I'm just so excited to see you that I got carried away for a moment there.

dialogues.speaker: Choiseul
dialogues.text: All in all, everything's on track at the Fontaine Research Institute. Reconstruction is now officially on the schedule as well.

dialogues.speaker: Choiseul
dialogues.text: In fact, we've already begun work on some lighter projects, and we're about to start recruiting researchers again.

dialogues.speaker: Choiseul
dialogues.text: We're flourishing, wouldn't you say? It's fantastic!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Looks like everything's fine at the Institute today.

dialogues.speaker: Choiseul
dialogues.text: Of course, everything is running smoothly, like clockwork! This is how the New Fontaine Research Institute operates, it's truly incredible!

dialogues.speaker: Choiseul
dialogues.text: But the negative influence Edwin Eastinghouse had on the Fontaine Research Institute cannot be erased overnight. We still have much work ahead of us.

dialogues.speaker: Choiseul
dialogues.text: First, we must guarantee that researchers have an excellent environment conducive to their work! This will also encourage them to engage in fair and beneficial competition...
